events.comment: The content (chapters, archangels, shadow-thoughts, gifts…) comes from assets/data/content.json, built by tools/build-content.mjs. The save lives in the browser storage and is merged over the defaults of the global variable Save.

The Ladder lies on the ground like an icon seen from above: rails and rungs (Content.ladder.paths), a sphere on each rung (gold when done, white when open, dark when locked), Christ at the top. The guardian archangel stands by the chosen rung.
The camera and the archangel glide to the chosen rung.
A click on a sphere chooses it (the cursor is projected on the ground of the 3D layer).
Lasting talents bought with manna (Ga 5,22-23), applied in the Arena; deterministic and never lost. After a purchase the panel is built again (Reopen).

parameters: "Manna: " + ToString(Save.manna) + " · „Ale owoc Ducha jest miłość, wesele, pokój…” (Ga 5,22)"

events.comment: Two parts: the lies whose strongholds fell, with the truth and a verse; and the thoughts met on the way, how each one lies, the question that tests it and what it turns into.

parameters: "Księga jest jeszcze pusta. Każda zburzona twierdza zapisze tu kłamstwo, które upadło, i prawdę, która je zastąpiła."

events.comment: Thoughts: every shadow-thought seen at least once, with its painting.

parameters: "Tu zapiszą się myśli, które przemienisz w walce: jak kłamią i co mówią naprawdę."

events.comment: Skills learned in the chapters (Save.tools): what it is, the steps, the challenge for today, and what research says. Breathing can be practised here.

parameters: "Po każdej zburzonej twierdzy dostaniesz tu jedno prawdziwe narzędzie: sposób radzenia sobie z myślami i uczuciami, sprawdzony w badaniach."

events.comment: Cyclic sighing: in through the nose (4 s), a short second sip (1 s), a long slow breath out (8 s); six rounds. Exhale-focused breathing has moderate evidence for lowering stress (Balban 2023).

parameters: "Dobrze. Zauważ, jak teraz czuje się twoje ciało."
"Oddech " + ToString(min(6, floor(BreathT / 13) + 1)) + " z 6 · możesz zamknąć oczy"
